errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (中国社会科学院) to the color dark gray (深灰). According to the legend in the image, the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences is represented by dark blue, while dark gray represents Beijing Foreign Studies University (北京外国语大学).
The description maps Beijing Foreign Studies University (北京外国语大学) to the color black (黑). The color in the legend is clearly dark gray (深灰), not black.
